skill.name: file-uploads
skill.description: Guides secure file upload and cloud storage design for S3, Cloudflare R2, presigned URLs, multipart uploads, and image optimization.
skill.summary: Helps design secure, scalable file upload flows with cloud storage and presigned URLs.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: Static analysis found no suspicious patterns and no executable code. The skill is prompt-only and focuses on secure file upload architecture, including validation, size limits, sanitized filenames, and presigned URL controls.

content.value_statement: File uploads can create security, performance, and storage problems. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code plan safer upload flows.
actual_capabilities: Explains when to use presigned URLs instead of server proxy uploads.
Highlights upload risks such as untrusted file types, path traversal, and missing size limits.
Guides S3 and Cloudflare R2 storage design decisions.
Covers multipart upload planning for large files.
Includes security reminders for filename sanitization and content validation.
Supports image optimization discussions for uploaded assets.
limitations: Does not include executable upload code or deployment scripts.
Does not validate files, scan malware, or inspect storage buckets directly.
Does not replace cloud provider documentation for exact API behavior.
Requires project details to produce implementation-specific guidance.

use_cases.title: Plan a direct-to-storage upload flow
use_cases.description: Design a presigned URL flow that keeps large uploads away from the application server.

use_cases.title: Review upload security controls
use_cases.description: Check file type validation, size limits, filename handling, and presigned URL distribution risks.

use_cases.title: Improve media upload performance
use_cases.description: Plan multipart uploads and image optimization for applications with large or frequent media files.

prompt_templates.title: Choose an Upload Architecture
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me choose a secure file upload architecture for my app. Compare server proxy uploads and presigned URL uploads.

prompt_templates.title: Review Upload Risks
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this upload design for security gaps. Focus on file type validation, size limits, filenames, and presigned URL exposure.

prompt_templates.title: Design Large File Uploads
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a large file upload flow using multipart uploads. Include retry behavior, progress tracking, cleanup, and storage constraints.
prompt_templates.scenario: Team adding support for large uploads

prompt_templates.title: Compare S3 and R2 Implementation Details
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare S3 and Cloudflare R2 for this upload workflow. Include presigned URLs, multipart behavior, image optimization, and security controls.

output_examples.input: I need users to upload profile photos without overloading my server.
output_examples.output: Use presigned URLs, enforce small size limits, verify image content, sanitize filenames, and process thumbnails after storage confirmation.

output_examples.input: Our app needs video uploads up to several gigabytes.
output_examples.output: Use multipart uploads with resumable client behavior, short-lived upload credentials, strict object keys, and cleanup for abandoned parts.

output_examples.input: I want to check whether my upload design is safe.
output_examples.output: Review magic byte validation, maximum size rules, filename normalization, storage permissions, and where presigned URLs can be shared.

best_practices: Validate file content with magic bytes instead of trusting extensions.
Use strict upload size limits and cleanup rules for incomplete uploads.
Prefer short-lived presigned URLs with narrow permissions.
anti_patterns: Trusting client-provided file names or file types.
Proxying large uploads through the application server without need.
Caching or sharing presigned URLs beyond their intended user and time window.

faq.question: Does this skill upload files for me?
faq.answer: No. It provides architecture and security guidance for building upload flows.

faq.question: Can it help with S3 and Cloudflare R2?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill covers both S3 and Cloudflare R2 upload design topics.

faq.question: Does it cover presigned URLs?
faq.answer: Yes. It recommends presigned URLs and explains risks around sharing and caching them.

faq.question: Can it help with large files?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers multipart uploads and large file handling considerations.

faq.question: Does it validate file safety automatically?
faq.answer: No. It can recommend validation controls, but it does not inspect uploaded files.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: It is listed for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
